description: Tape with NT-style adjacent same-time/same-side merging and a MinVolume=30 filter. At t=5000 two adjacent buys (20+15) merge to 35 (emit) and one sell (10) does not reach the floor (no emit). At t=6000 a single buy of 40 emits. At t=7000 a sell of 12 is below the floor (no emit). Sides are forced by explicit bid/ask. Expected markers derived by hand from the BigTradeIndicator merge + filter rules.
